analysis_code_commit: Git commit containing this new directory

software.matlab: not used; read retained formal MAT

signal: var(abs(E),1,3), denominator N; linear raw SV

geometry.source: unchanged X1 x physical diameter ellipse, centered X4
geometry.tail: frozen X1 rectangle below true physical bottom, guard 0

normalized_tail_calculation: direct integration at physical boundaries; no map interpolation
experimental_unit: scan volume; no p-values, no pooled frames

analysis_parameters.primary: 6 source bins x 20 nonoverlapping 25um bands; mean-mean, 51-frame residual, lag0
analysis_parameters.full_lag_scope: 6 bins, mean-mean, raw/31/51/101, both tail coordinates
analysis_parameters.detrend: centered median, original 0..499 grid, min_periods=1, truncated edges; invalid center remains NaN
analysis_parameters.spearman: average ranks per pairwise-valid set; no p-values
analysis_parameters.controls: source_area+z_top primary; X1+z_top sensitivity; controls detrended with signals in residual modes
analysis_parameters.high_region: ceil(0.10 * number of positive cells), top signed rho, includes ties at cutoff; empty if no positive cells
analysis_parameters.peak_ties: cell: smallest source_bin then tail_bin; lag: smallest |lag| then smaller signed lag
analysis_parameters.specificity: rho(0) minus median rho at absolute lag 30..50 inclusive
analysis_parameters.flow_similarity: Spearman of aligned map cells, ten pairs per diameter; map cells not independent replicates
analysis_parameters.source_resolution_map_comparison: piecewise constant replication on LCM source rows only for shape diagnostic; no new quantitative SV and no tail-coordinate interpolation
analysis_parameters.Q_status: Q–Q analysis includes signal-intensity and ROI-geometry contributions and is secondary to mean–mean analysis.

script_identity_note: extraction_script_sha256 and analysis_script_sha256 identify the executed numerical scripts. all_script_sha256 identifies the delivered scripts after explicit UTF-8 JSON reads, verification-index sorting, and report metadata repair; numerical definitions are unchanged.
